packageRules.description: Keep GitHub Actions pinned and updated deliberately.

The generated Node 24 target's @types/node stays on the 24.x line; the pin has to equal the engines.node floor it ships beside. A cross-major bump here is caught at import time by the assertion in generated-versions.ts.
The generated Node 26 target's @types/node stays on the 26.x line, for the same reason.
The generator's own @types/node matches its own engines.node floor of >=24. Node 25 is never a valid target: it is an odd line that never becomes LTS.

customManagers.description: Track quoted npm dependencies embedded in generated package.json templates.

Track the per-Node-target @types/node pins. The generic manager above cannot read them: that object is keyed by Node major rather than by package name, which is also why its depName pattern requires a leading letter.
Track the template-only meow dependency emitted into generated package.json files.
Track the template-only jsr dependency emitted into generated package.json files.
Track the template-only tsdown dependency emitted into generated package.json files.

Track SHA-pinned GitHub Actions emitted into generated workflows. The github-actions manager only reads workflow YAML, so without this the copies in githubActionRefs drift and scaffolded projects stay pinned to stale actions.
Track the pinned Semgrep version used by the security lint wrapper and its generated copy.
